name: aceternity-ui-3d-pin
blurb: Card that tilts in 3D on hover with a floating perspective effect.
description: A clickable card container that rotates on the X-axis when hovered, scales down, and displays a floating perspective tooltip. Uses CSS 3D transforms and Motion for smooth transitions.
use_when: Feature showcases, portfolio cards, or product displays where 3D depth enhances focus.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users (no prefers-reduced-motion support); mobile/touch (3D feels jarring).
a11y: Wraps an anchor; hover effects only. No keyboard navigation beyond link focus.
